# SCI-FLT-MATCHED_TO_SCI-FRUIT v0.1/r0.4

Status: second-review finite one-way producer-envelope draft; no FRUIT
contract, algorithm, implementation, or use is authorized

Producer: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`

Future consumer authority: `SCI-FRUIT` successor contract tranche

FLT preserves a first-class interface sufficient for a future authorized FRUIT
method to consume the filtered amplitude product without reconstructing
undocumented FLT implementation state. The finite v0.1 FLT-owned vocabulary
`Q_FLT^0.1` contains exactly:

- filtered quantity and per-anchor value, validity, and lifecycle;
- parent and anchor identity/WCS;
- template identity and unit-amplitude convention;
- predeclared local domain and final application support;
- fixed-state scientific and available operational-realized/reference response
  identities, including the operational derivative/finite-difference
  specification;
- method, complete frozen condition, resolved state, producing-map, and
  numerical-profile identities;
- every named U1/U2 covariance role's identity, lifecycle status, selected
  scope, fixed codomain when available, and companion availability;
- units/calibration and immutable provenance; and
- the exact supported state and response query declarations.

Selected `AO-004` representation is required for state reconstruction and
selected `AO-005` representation for response reconstruction. Unsupported
queries are typed unavailable. A future FRUIT method requiring a query outside
`Q_FLT^0.1` requires a successor FLT envelope or generation; existing signal
products remain unchanged. A fixed-state response is not strengthened into
full-procedure response by the consumer.

This envelope defines no FRUIT source model, subtraction/add-back, recurrence,
learning, stopping, restart, selection, response, uncertainty, convergence, or
interpretation. No SRC boundary is created. A genuine FRUIT method receives a
separate scientific contract tranche.
